personalisation_line: Opening a Head of Marketing role while you still own pipeline yourself is a particular kind of pressure.
A fresh Series A means the board now expects pipeline growth that founder-led sales rarely delivers alone.
Three GTM roles open at once usually means pipeline is behind plan and hiring alone won't fix it fast.
Writing publicly about outbound that isn't landing usually means the targeting and not the copy is the problem.
A CRM full of contacts and no outbound tooling usually means pipeline depends on referrals and inbound alone.
